creators.name: Rick Steves
creators.reach: Best-known US public-TV Europe travel authority (long-running PBS series 'Rick Steves' Europe', best-selling guidebooks, millions of readers/viewers)
creators.covers: Germany's Mosel Valley — dedicated destination guide and articles naming Beilstein as his favourite Mosel village ('Cinderella-land') and the St.-Nikolaus-Hospital Vinothek in Bernkastel-Kues as the place to start tasting Mosel wine.
creators.note: Used as a credible authority-source toward the >=2-credible bar for Beilstein and the Bernkastel vinotheque, not as a lone recommender.
